'''Fleet [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]''' was a rank in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. [[Orley Vanicus]] held it. [[Dace Golliard]] served as a fleet captain for [[the Crucible]].

The rank was also used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="GH">{{JournalCite|1|A Glimmer of Hope}}</ref>
